The most underrated country in the Middle East 🇴🇲 Oman’s rich culture, people, nature, food has made it one of our favourite spots ❤️

Let us know if you have any questions about Oman below and we’ll answer👇

Top things to do in Oman:
🏰 Visit Nizwa + Nizwa Fort (Nizwa is approx 3 hour drive from Muscat. The entrance fee to the fort is approx $18 cad pp for Nizwa Fort)
🕌Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque (Ibadi practice)
🏝️ Day trip to Daymaniyat Islands
🏰 Visit Mutrah Fort (Overall a bit underwhelming but the views were great! Entrance fee was approx $10 cad pp. They have a small cafe at the top with beautiful views!)
🛍️ Shop at local markets & souqs (& buy a traditional Omani thobe!)
🍽️ Dine at local traditional Omani restaurants & explore the cafe scene (Top fav eats reel coming up soon!)

Notes:
•Omani Rial - OMR ranks the third highest currency in the
world. 1 CAD = $3.60 BUT the currency value goes along way
(wasn't as expensive as we thought)
• Renting a car is probably the best option to explore Oman. It's easy to drive around but speed cameras everywhere
• The locals are soo friendly! Extremely hospitable. Two random families invited us over for dinner at their house 🥹❤️
• Truly a very underrated spot and would def recommend!

Incorrect disposal of litter/trash can have negative impacts on our city, neighbors and environment🚮

In addition to the misplaced items mentioned in the reel, below are also the most common litter items in Toronto which should to be disposed of in a garbage bin:
🍬Gum: Used chewing gum (and its wrapping) belongs in the garbage.
🚬Cigarette Butts: Toronto street litter bins have a special receptacle designated for cigarette butt disposal.
😷Personal Protective Equipment: Masks, gloves and other personal protective equipment are to be thrown in the Garbage Bin.
🤧Paper Towels and Napkins: If there is a Green Bin nearby, these can be disposed of in the Green Bin. Otherwise, they should be disposed of in the Garbage Bin.

Please do your part in properly disposing of litter in the Garbage Bins (grey), Blue Bins (recycling) and Green Bins (organics) on the streets of Toronto

caption:
Our wedding cake❤️

One of the best decisions we made for the wedding was having @_decocake design and bake our wedding cake🎂💍

We’ve never met anyone as talented her….Her eye for detail, her intricate designs are mind-blowing. We were all shocked when we found out the flowers on our cake weren’t actually real but were hand-made by HER! We can’t imagine the number of hours that went into making these flowers alone.

Our guests LOVED the cake. Some said it was the best wedding cake they’ve had (which I agree with)- it was so fluffy, light and just perfect. The flavours & fillings complimented each other and were divine. One tier was chocolate with Nutella filling and the other tier was vanilla with Lotus filling…the perfect combo!

We made sure we had some caked saved for us which was the best decision ever since I remember eating it for breakfast, lunch AND dinner the next few days😂

We would highly highly recommend the talented @_decocake for all your baking needs💕
